headings.title: Unlawful merchandising practices declared
headings.reviewNote: Covers prohibited acts in trade, commerce, and charitable solicitations.

headings.title: Exemptions from merchandising practices provisions
headings.reviewNote: Specifies exceptions for media publishers, regulated entities, and new home warranties.

headings.title: Criminal penalty for willful fraud
headings.reviewNote: Establishes class E felony for willful merchandising violations with intent to defraud.

headings.title: Prosecutorial jurisdiction for criminal violations
headings.reviewNote: Specifies prosecutorial duties and concurrent statewide jurisdiction of the attorney general.

headings.title: Long-term care facility quality disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits long-term care facilities (excluding residential care and assisted living facilities) from refusing copies of care evaluations, allowing resident redaction and reasonable fees.

headings.title: Civil liability for facility violations
headings.reviewNote: Provides civil damages and attorney fees for long-term care facility violations.

entries.reviewSummary: Declares unlawful merchandising practices, outlines statutory exceptions, establishes criminal penalties, specifies prosecuting authority, and sets standards for long-term care facility disclosures.

headings.title: Proof of business agency required
headings.reviewNote: Requires written proof of agency to rent trade show space.

headings.title: Unlawful merchandising practice designation
headings.reviewNote: Designates violations of trade show representation requirements as unlawful merchandising practices.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs representation of businesses at wholesale trade shows and defines unlawful merchandising practices for unauthorized space rental.

headings.title: Private civil action for damages
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes consumer suits for ascertainable losses from unlawful practices.

headings.title: Punitive damages and equitable relief
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court discretion to award punitive damages, attorney fees, and equitable remedies.

headings.title: Exclusion of certain injury claims
headings.reviewNote: Bars actions for personal injury or death subject to chapter 538.

headings.title: Accrual of cause of action
headings.reviewNote: Defines the accrual date for private civil merchandising claims.

headings.title: Class action authorization and standards
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes class actions and specifies proof requirements for class representatives.

headings.title: Class action maintenance prerequisites
headings.reviewNote: Sets procedural criteria for maintaining actions under civil procedure rules.

headings.title: Class certification order and notice
headings.reviewNote: Governs class determination orders, exclusion requests, and member notice requirements.

headings.title: Court orders governing class conduct
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes procedural orders to manage class proceedings and prevent repetition.

headings.title: Court approval for class compromise
headings.reviewNote: Requires court approval and notice prior to dismissing or compromising class actions.

headings.title: Notice to attorney general
headings.reviewNote: Requires plaintiffs to inform the court clerk and the clerk to notify the attorney general of subsection 1 action filings and judgments.

headings.title: Injunctions as prima facie evidence
headings.reviewNote: Establishes evidentiary weight of section 407.100 injunctions in private civil actions.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes private civil actions and class action procedures for consumers damaged by unlawful merchandising practices.

headings.title: Assurance of voluntary compliance acceptance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes attorney general to accept court-approved written assurances of voluntary compliance.

headings.title: Civil penalty for assurance violation
headings.reviewNote: Imposes civil penalties for violating voluntary compliance assurances and retains court jurisdiction.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes the attorney general to accept written assurances of voluntary compliance and provides penalties for violations.

headings.title: Civil investigative demand authorization
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes attorney general to serve investigative demands for testimony and evidence.

headings.title: Contents of investigative demand
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required statutory references, descriptions, return dates, and staff designations.

headings.title: Limitations on investigative demands
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits unreasonable requirements and privileged disclosures under investigative demands.

headings.title: Methods of service for demands
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes delivery and certified mailing procedures for serving investigative demands.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs the issuance, contents, limitations, and service of civil investigative demands by the attorney general.

headings.title: Confidentiality of investigative material
headings.reviewNote: Restricts disclosure of demand materials while authorizing law enforcement sharing.

headings.title: Court approval for trade secrets
headings.reviewNote: Requires court approval before presenting trade secret materials in judicial proceedings.

entries.reviewSummary: Restricts disclosure of materials obtained under investigative demands and establishes court protections for trade secrets.

headings.title: Prohibitory orders by attorney general
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes orders prohibiting unlawful acts after notice giving two business days to file an answer.

headings.title: Execution and expiration of orders
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes signature, service methods, and ten-day expiration for prohibitory orders.

headings.title: Criminal penalty for violating order
headings.reviewNote: Establishes class E felony for willful and knowing violation of prohibitory orders.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes attorney general prohibitory orders against unlawful practices and establishes procedures and criminal penalties.

headings.title: Injunction actions by attorney general
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes circuit court injunctions against persons engaging in unlawful merchandising practices.

headings.title: Restraining orders and asset sequestering
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes temporary restraining orders, preliminary injunctions, receivers, and fund sequestering.

headings.title: Orders to prevent recurring practices
headings.reviewNote: Empowers courts to enter necessary orders preventing future prohibited merchandising acts.

headings.title: Restitution orders and interest remittance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes restitution for ascertainable losses and requires interest deposit into general revenue.

headings.title: Appointment of receiver for compliance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appointment of receivers to enforce court orders and restitution payments.

headings.title: Civil penalty assessment and exception
headings.reviewNote: Permits civil penalties up to one thousand dollars with exception for bona fide error.

headings.title: Venue for enforcement actions
headings.reviewNote: Establishes venue in county of residence, violation occurrence, or principal business place.

headings.title: Consent judgments and injunctions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes consent judgments and consent injunctions without admission of statutory violations.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs attorney general injunction proceedings, temporary restraining orders, receiverships, restitution, civil penalties, and consent judgments.

headings.title: Application for administrative hearing
headings.reviewNote: Specifies application filing, notice, scheduling, and stay requirements before the commission.

headings.title: Administrative procedure and appellate review
headings.reviewNote: Governs hearing procedures under chapter 536 and exclusive court of appeals review.

headings.title: Franchisee right to hearing
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes franchisees to seek hearing on good cause for franchisor actions.

headings.title: Notice requirements for franchisor actions
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes notice periods and grounds for franchisor termination or business changes.

headings.title: Required contents of franchisor notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires franchisor notices to state particular grounds and include a conspicuous first-page fifteen-day protest warning.

headings.title: Consolidation of hearing applications
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the administrative hearing commission to consolidate multiple related franchise applications.

headings.title: Burden of proof allocation
headings.reviewNote: Allocates burden of proof between franchisor and franchisee in commission proceedings.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes administrative hearing commission procedures and notice requirements for motorcycle and all-terrain vehicle franchise disputes.

headings.title: Relevant market area defined
headings.reviewNote: Defines mileage radii for relevant market areas based on county population.

headings.title: Relocation distance threshold
headings.reviewNote: Excludes moves within two miles from statutory relocation requirements.

headings.title: Motor vehicle definition inclusion
headings.reviewNote: Includes motorcycles and all-terrain vehicles within motor vehicle statutory references.

headings.title: Notice of franchise establishment
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice to existing line-make franchisees before establishing or relocating dealers.

headings.title: Franchisee action on good cause
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes franchisee action to challenge good cause for proposed establishment or relocation.

headings.title: Exception for reopened closed dealerships
headings.reviewNote: Exempts reopened dealerships within two miles closed within the preceding year.

headings.title: Good cause evaluation factors
headings.reviewNote: Specifies statutory criteria for evaluating good cause for additional or relocated franchises.

headings.title: Applicability of statutory remedies
headings.reviewNote: Applies remedies and relief under section 407.1049 to market area disputes.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines relevant market areas and procedural requirements for establishing or relocating motorcycle and all-terrain vehicle franchises.

headings.title: Scope of compensation provisions
headings.reviewNote: Applies warranty compensation provisions to motorcycle and all-terrain vehicle franchises.

headings.title: Written warranty service obligations
headings.reviewNote: Requires franchisors to specify franchisee warranty obligations in writing and compensate service.

headings.title: Warranty compensation schedule and rates
headings.reviewNote: Mandates reasonable compensation schedules and minimum labor rates equal to retail charges.

headings.title: Prohibited franchisor warranty practices
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits franchisor failure to perform warranty obligations, notify recalls, or compensate repairs.

headings.title: Warranty claim approval and payment
headings.reviewNote: Requires claim payment within thirty days and limits charge-back audit periods.

headings.title: Compensation for promotional events
headings.reviewNote: Requires franchisor compensation for sponsored sales and service promotional activities.

headings.title: Promotional claim timelines and audit
headings.reviewNote: Sets timelines for promotional claim approval, payment, and twelve-month charge-back audits, with holdback and balance-forward exceptions; original rolls use 'subparagraphs' for 'subdivisions'.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs warranty and promotional compensation agreements between franchisors and franchisees selling motorcycles and all-terrain vehicles.

headings.title: Venue for transfer approval
headings.reviewNote: Specifies proper circuit court venue for structured settlement transfer approval applications.

headings.title: Notice of transfer hearing
headings.reviewNote: Requires twenty days' advance notice to interested parties with application and disclosures.

headings.title: Prohibition against statutory waiver
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits waiver of statutory provisions governing structured settlement transfers.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs court applications, hearing notices, and nonwaivability for transfers of structured settlement payment rights.

headings.title: Payee right to rescind agreement
headings.reviewNote: Grants payees an absolute right to cancel transfer agreements within five days.

headings.title: Unenforceability of penalty provisions
headings.reviewNote: Invalidates transfer agreement provisions requiring liquidated damages, penalties, fees, damages, attorney's fees, or costs to parties or third-party beneficiaries.

headings.title: Preservation of existing tort law
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits transfers violating existing laws governing tort or workers' compensation claims.

headings.title: Unenforceability of foreign jurisdiction clauses
headings.reviewNote: Invalidates clauses selecting out-of-state jurisdiction, confessing judgment, or choosing foreign forums.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes payee rescission rights and renders certain contractual restrictions unenforceable in structured settlement transfers.

headings.title: Prompt telemarketing disclosures required
headings.reviewNote: Mandates prompt, clear, and conspicuous disclosures of sales purpose, entity identity, merchandise, prize rules, and automated calls.

headings.title: Required pre-payment transaction disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Requires disclosures of cost, quantity, restrictions, refund policy, and investment details before payment.

headings.title: Prohibited prize promotion misrepresentations
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits telemarketers from misrepresenting a prize's description, market value, quantity, or award date.

headings.title: Prohibited merchandise characteristic misrepresentations
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits telemarketers from misrepresenting material performance, quality, efficacy, nature, or basic characteristics of merchandise.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes required consumer disclosures and prohibited telemarketing misrepresentations before and during sales solicitations.

headings.title: Telemarketing record retention required
headings.reviewNote: Mandates twenty-four month retention of promotional materials, prize records, customer data, and employee lists.

headings.title: Truth in lending credit compliance
headings.reviewNote: Provides that compliance with federal Truth in Lending satisfies customer credit record requirements.

headings.title: Allocation of recordkeeping responsibilities
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes written agreements allocating record-keeping duties between sellers and telemarketers.

headings.title: Retention upon business dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Requires records maintenance following business dissolution, sale, or ownership transfer.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires telemarketers and sellers to maintain marketing and sales records and allocates record-keeping responsibilities.

headings.title: Unlawful merchandising practice designation
headings.reviewNote: Subjects telemarketing disclosure violations to chapter 407 penalties and remedies.

headings.title: Criminal penalties for telemarketing violations
headings.reviewNote: Establishes misdemeanors and felonies for unlawful telemarketing acts and recordkeeping failures.

headings.title: Private consumer action for damages
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes consumers suffering harm from unlawful telemarketing to recover actual and punitive damages.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes criminal penalties, statutory merchandising remedies, and private consumer damages for telemarketing violations.

headings.title: Exemptions from telemarketing regulations
headings.reviewNote: Exempts face-to-face follow-ups, regulated financial products, consumer-initiated calls, and business-to-business transactions.

headings.title: Attorney general complaint intake
headings.reviewNote: Directs attorney general to receive telemarketing complaints and forward regulated entity matters.

entries.reviewSummary: Exempts specific business transactions from telemarketing regulations and establishes complaint intake procedures in the attorney general's office.

headings.title: Establishment of no-call database
headings.reviewNote: Directs attorney general to establish database of residential subscribers objecting to solicitations.

headings.title: Rulemaking for database operation
headings.reviewNote: Directs the attorney general to promulgate rules for notice methods, effective periods, collection, and telemarketer access fees.

headings.title: Inclusion of federal database
headings.reviewNote: Requires inclusion of Missouri listings from the single national Federal Communications Commission database.

headings.title: Confidentiality of subscriber information
headings.reviewNote: Restricts database information use to compliance and enforcement and exempts open records.

headings.title: Periodic update of subscriber listings
headings.reviewNote: Encourages quarterly updates of residential subscribers registered on national do-not-call lists.

headings.title: Funding sources for database operation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes general revenue and revolving fund appropriations for database establishment and operation.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking compliance standards
headings.reviewNote: Conditions rulemaking validity on compliance with chapter 536 administrative procedures.

entries.reviewSummary: Directs the attorney general to establish and operate the state no-call database and governs rules, funding, and confidentiality.

headings.title: Solicitor identity disclosure required
headings.reviewNote: Requires telephone solicitors to state the identity of initiating entity at beginning of call.

headings.title: Prohibition against blocking caller identification
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits solicitors from knowingly blocking or circumventing subscriber caller identification services.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires telephone solicitors to state their identity and prohibits blocking caller identification services.

headings.title: Attorney general enforcement proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes attorney general to seek injunctions, civil penalties, and investigative subpoenas.

headings.title: Cumulative statutory penalties and remedies
headings.reviewNote: Applies chapter 407 remedies and procedures cumulatively to caller identification violations.

headings.title: Private action for repetitive solicitations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes private suits for injunctions and damages up to five thousand dollars per violation.

headings.title: Affirmative defense of reasonable procedures
headings.reviewNote: Establishes defense where solicitor implemented reasonable practices with due care to prevent violations.

headings.title: Statute of limitations for actions
headings.reviewNote: Establishes two-year limitation period from discovery or state enforcement termination.

headings.title: Personal jurisdiction over nonresidents
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes personal jurisdiction over nonresident solicitors and personal representatives.

headings.title: Nonexclusive cumulative remedies
headings.reviewNote: Provides that statutory telemarketing remedies and prohibitions are nonexclusive and cumulative.

headings.title: Immunity for caller ID providers
headings.reviewNote: Immunizes caller identification service providers from liability for solicitor violations.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs enforcement of telemarketing and caller ID laws, specifying civil penalties, private actions, defenses, and limitations.

headings.title: Toll-free number or return email required
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits unsolicited advertising emails without a toll-free number or valid return email address.

headings.title: Unlawful assistance in email transmission
headings.reviewNote: Designates assisting unlawful commercial electronic mail transmission as an unlawful merchandising practice.

headings.title: Network carrier transmission exemption
headings.reviewNote: Exempts telecommunications utilities and internet service providers acting merely as network carriers.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits unsolicited commercial electronic mail without contact disclosures and defines unlawful assistance by intermediaries, subject to contingent expiration under section 407.1132.

headings.title: Statutory damages for email recipients
headings.reviewNote: Provides five hundred dollars statutory damages or actual damages for recipients of unlawful emails.

headings.title: Damages for interactive computer services
headings.reviewNote: Provides one thousand dollars statutory damages or actual damages for interactive computer services.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes statutory and actual damages for recipients and interactive computer services harmed by unsolicited commercial emails, subject to contingent expiration under section 407.1132.

headings.title: Authority to block unlawful emails
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes interactive computer services to block receipt or transmission of suspected unlawful emails.

headings.title: Good faith blocking immunity
headings.reviewNote: Immunizes interactive computer services from liability for good faith actions blocking unlawful emails.

headings.title: Contingent expiration upon federal legislation
headings.reviewNote: Provides sections 407.1120 to 407.1132 have no force and effect upon enactment of federal unsolicited commercial email law; revisor's note cites the 2003 CAN-SPAM Act.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes interactive computer services to block unlawful commercial emails with civil immunity and specifies contingent expiration upon federal legislation.

headings.title: False subject line information prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits false identities or misleading information in subject lines of commercial emails.

headings.title: Mandatory advertising label in subject line
headings.reviewNote: Requires unsolicited commercial emails to use 'ADV:' as the first four subject characters.

headings.title: Adult content subject line label
headings.reviewNote: Requires commercial emails containing obscene material to use 'ADV:ADLT' as the first eight characters.

headings.title: Transmission after opt-out notice prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits initiating commercial emails to recipients who have provided notice to opt out.

headings.title: Attorney general rulemaking authority
headings.reviewNote: Directs the attorney general to promulgate rules and regulations deemed necessary to implement sections 407.1135 to 407.1141.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits deceptive subject lines, mandates standard subject headers, and authorizes attorney general rulemaking for electronic mail.

headings.title: Attorney general proceedings and penalties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes attorney general injunctions, subpoenas, and civil penalties up to $5,000 per knowing violation, not exceeding $25,000 per day.

headings.title: Cumulative statutory merchandising remedies
headings.reviewNote: Applies chapter 407 remedies cumulatively and credits recovered civil penalties to revolving fund.

headings.title: Affirmative defense of reasonable prevention
headings.reviewNote: Establishes defense where sender implemented reasonable practices with due care to prevent violations.

headings.title: Statute of limitations for proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Establishes two-year limitation period from discovery or conclusion of state enforcement proceedings.

headings.title: Personal jurisdiction over nonresidents
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes state courts to exercise personal jurisdiction over nonresident email violators.

headings.title: Liability immunity for email and internet providers
headings.reviewNote: Exempts telecommunications utilities, email service providers, and internet service providers from liability for intermediary transmission or good faith blocking.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes attorney general enforcement, civil penalties, defenses, and jurisdictional rules for unlawful commercial electronic mail.

headings.title: Definitions for criminal record publication
headings.reviewNote: Defines booking photograph, criminal record information, and subject individual.

headings.title: Payment to remove criminal records prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits publishers from soliciting or accepting payment to remove or correct criminal records.

headings.title: Criminal penalty for unlawful solicitation
headings.reviewNote: Establishes class A misdemeanor for willfully soliciting payment to remove criminal record information.

headings.title: Separate violation per payment transaction
headings.reviewNote: Designates each payment solicited or accepted as a separate statutory violation.

headings.title: Civil damages and attorney fees
headings.reviewNote: Allows awarding $10,000 or actual and punitive damages (whichever is greater) plus attorney fees and costs, with humiliation or embarrassment sufficient to show damages.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits demanding payment to remove or correct published criminal records and establishes criminal and civil liability.

headings.title: Travel club registration requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires an effective registration statement disclosing club names, affiliates, governance documents, owners, sales addresses, registered agent, memberships, and at least $250,000 in liquid assets.

headings.title: Attorney general review and approval
headings.reviewNote: Specifies thirty-day attorney general review and fifteen-day notice of registration deficiencies.

headings.title: Preexisting travel club operational transition
headings.reviewNote: Allows preexisting clubs to operate during registration review and prohibits registration transfers.

headings.title: Registration statement contract and fee
headings.reviewNote: Requires submission of membership contract form with rescission notice and fifty-dollar fee.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes registration, disclosure, liquid asset, transition, contract form, and fee requirements for travel clubs operating in the state.

headings.title: Travel club complaint filing and delivery
headings.reviewNote: Governs complaint filing with attorney general and requires ten-day transmittal to travel club.

headings.title: Travel club thirty-day cure period
headings.reviewNote: Provides travel club thirty business days to cure grievances and execute mutual settlement release.

headings.title: Injunction actions and felony penalty
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes enforcement actions, establishes class E felony, and directs fines to school funds.

headings.title: Surety bond for refund failures
headings.reviewNote: Requires posting surety bond for failing to provide timely rescission refunds or honor settlements.

headings.title: Security bond for travel club fraud
headings.reviewNote: Requires posting security bond following judicial finding of fraud in contract procurement.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes complaint procedures, opportunity to cure, felony penalties, and surety bond mandates for travel club violations.

headings.title: Written RV dealership agreement required
headings.reviewNote: Mandates written agreements signed by both parties and supersedes conflicting state statutes.

headings.title: Exclusive sales area and additional dealers
headings.reviewNote: Requires written sales territory assignment and good cause showing for appointing competing dealers.

headings.title: Published prices and nondiscriminatory terms
headings.reviewNote: Requires sales at published prices and equal terms regarding rebates, discounts, and programs.

headings.title: Good cause required for termination
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits termination without good cause, mandates renewal negotiations, and requires notice of competing lines.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs written agreement requirements, assigned sales areas, pricing terms, and termination standards for recreational vehicle manufacturers and dealers.

headings.title: Notice of termination and right to cure
headings.reviewNote: Requires one hundred twenty days' notice and grants dealer thirty days to notify intent to cure.

headings.title: Shortened thirty-day termination notice
headings.reviewNote: Permits shortened thirty-day notice for felony conviction, abandonment, misrepresentation, or license suspension.

headings.title: Insolvency and bankruptcy notice exception
headings.reviewNote: Exempts termination based on insolvency, assignment for creditors, or bankruptcy from notice rules.

headings.title: Dealer termination notice requirement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes RV dealers to terminate agreements upon thirty days' prior written notice to manufacturers.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes written notice periods, right to cure, exceptions, and dealer termination rights for recreational vehicle dealer agreements.

headings.title: Notice of dealer ownership change
headings.reviewNote: Requires thirty days' advance notice of ownership change and limits manufacturer refusal grounds.

headings.title: Written rejection notice requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires manufacturer to provide written reasons within thirty days or transfer is deemed approved.

headings.title: Burden of proof on manufacturer
headings.reviewNote: Places burden of proof on manufacturer to demonstrate that transfer rejection is reasonable.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates recreational vehicle dealer ownership changes, manufacturer approval criteria, rejection notices, and burden of proof.

headings.title: Written warranty service schedule required
headings.reviewNote: Requires warrantor to provide written warranty obligations, compensation schedules, and diagnostic rates.

headings.title: Reasonable warranty labor compensation
headings.reviewNote: Mandates reasonable diagnostic and labor allowances based on actual dealer retail wage rates.

headings.title: Warranty parts reimbursement and markup
headings.reviewNote: Requires reimbursement at actual wholesale cost plus minimum thirty percent handling fee and freight.

headings.title: Warranty audit standards and cause
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes reasonable warranty audits and restricts claim denials to defined cause grounds.

headings.title: Deadline for dealer claim submission
headings.reviewNote: Requires RV dealers to submit warranty claims within thirty days after completing work.

headings.title: Notice of inability to repair
headings.reviewNote: Directs dealers to give prompt notice when unable to perform material or repetitive warranty repairs.

headings.title: Warrantor claim processing and payment
headings.reviewNote: Requires written claim disapproval within thirty days and payment within forty-five days.

headings.title: Prohibited warrantor warranty practices
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits warrantors from failing warranty obligations, omitting campaign parts dates, denying transit or warranty compensation, or misrepresenting or forcing dealer warranties.

headings.title: Prohibited dealer warranty practices
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits RV dealers from failing to perform predelivery inspections or transient-customer warranty service, or misrepresenting warranty terms.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs recreational vehicle warranty obligations, labor and parts compensation, claim processing, audits, and prohibited warrantor practices.

headings.title: Written disclosure of vehicle damage
headings.reviewNote: Requires written disclosure to dealers and consumers for uncorrected significant or substantial damage.

headings.title: Dealer notification and transit damage
headings.reviewNote: Requires dealer notice of transit damage by next business day and request to repair or reject.

headings.title: Reversion of ownership to manufacturer
headings.reviewNote: Provides that vehicle ownership reverts to manufacturer upon failure to authorize repairs or rejection.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires disclosure of damage to new recreational vehicles and governs damage notifications, repair authorizations, and ownership reversion.

headings.title: Dealership ownership by manufacturer prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits manufacturers from owning or operating dealerships, subject to temporary and transition exceptions.

headings.title: Allowable minority ownership conditions
headings.reviewNote: Permits manufacturer minority interests up to forty-five percent under defined agreement conditions.

headings.title: Grandfathered dealership ownership exception
headings.reviewNote: Exempts manufacturers owning or operating RV dealerships in the state as of August 28, 2001.

entries.reviewSummary: Restricts recreational vehicle manufacturers from owning or operating dealerships and defines allowable temporary and minority ownership exceptions.

headings.title: Prohibited Social Security number practices
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits public posting, unencrypted internet transmission, website access use, and employee ID use.

headings.title: Effective date for employee number restriction
headings.reviewNote: Specifies effective date after December 31, 2015, for restrictions on using last four digits.

headings.title: Permitted legal and internal uses
headings.reviewNote: Permits collecting, using, or releasing numbers as required by law or for internal verification.

headings.title: Public record document exemptions
headings.reviewNote: Exempts recorded documents and public records required to be open under chapter 610 or court rules.

headings.title: Federal health identifier program compliance
headings.reviewNote: Provides that compliance with federal unique patient health identifier laws satisfies state requirements.

entries.reviewSummary: Restricts public display and electronic transmission of Social Security numbers and provides internal and legal compliance exceptions.

headings.title: Notice of marine dealership termination
headings.reviewNote: Requires ninety days' notice with reasons and ninety-day opportunity to cure deficiencies.

headings.title: Good cause exception to notice
headings.reviewNote: Exempts cancellations based on statutory good cause from notice and cure provisions.

headings.title: Dealer termination notice requirement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes marine dealers to terminate agreements upon ninety days' written notice to manufacturers.

headings.title: Shortened sixty-day termination notice
headings.reviewNote: Permits sixty days' notice for felony convictions, business abandonment, misrepresentation, or license loss.

headings.title: Insolvency and bankruptcy notice exception
headings.reviewNote: Exempts terminations caused by insolvency, assignment for creditors, or bankruptcy from notice.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes written notice periods, cure opportunities, grounds for shortened notice, and dealer termination rights for marine dealership agreements.

headings.title: Notice of marine ownership change
headings.reviewNote: Requires ninety days' notice of ownership change and limits manufacturer grounds for withholding consent.

headings.title: Family succession designation and objections
headings.reviewNote: Protects dealer family succession rights and requires written manufacturer objections showing unreasonableness.

headings.title: Timeline for rejection of transfer
headings.reviewNote: Requires manufacturer written rejection within sixty days or transfer is deemed approved.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs ownership transfers and family succession rights for marine dealerships, establishing manufacturer notice and objection timelines.

headings.title: Request for credit report freeze
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes consumers to request security freeze by mail or reliable electronic means with identification.

headings.title: Agency timeline and fee limits
headings.reviewNote: Requires freeze placement within five business days and limits fees, exempting requests accompanied by an incident report under section 595.232 (transferred from 570.222).

headings.title: Written confirmation and access credentials
headings.reviewNote: Requires written confirmation, compliance instructions, and a unique identification number or password within ten business days.

headings.title: Prohibition against furnishing frozen report
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits furnishing frozen reports, subject to exceptions for court orders, prescreening, and accounts.

headings.title: Notice of official information changes
headings.reviewNote: Requires written confirmation within thirty days of posting changes to name, birth date, Social Security number, or address, excluding technical modifications.

headings.title: Temporary lift request procedures
headings.reviewNote: Specifies consumer procedures to request temporary freeze lift for specific parties or time periods.

headings.title: Agency duties for lifting freeze
headings.reviewNote: Requires temporary freeze lift within fifteen minutes electronically during business hours or three days by mail, with specified outage extensions.

headings.title: Permanent removal of security freeze
headings.reviewNote: Requires permanent freeze removal within three days of consumer request with proper identification.

headings.title: Fee limits for temporary lift
headings.reviewNote: Permits fee up to five dollars for temporary lift but prohibits fees for victims or permanent removal.

headings.title: Mandatory consumer rights disclosure notice
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes statutory text explaining consumer rights and procedural effects of security freezes.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes consumers to request credit report security freezes, prescribes agency duties, exceptions, temporary lifts, removal, fees, and disclosure notices.

headings.title: Agency liability for actual damages
headings.reviewNote: Imposes liability on credit reporting agencies for actual damages, costs, and reasonable attorney fees.

headings.title: Equitable relief to restore credit
headings.reviewNote: Directs courts to award equitable relief to restore credit and deter future freeze violations.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes civil liability, actual damages, attorney fees, and equitable relief for credit reporting agency violations of security freeze requirements.

headings.title: Establishment of revolving trust fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates Merchandising Practices Revolving Fund in state treasury for attorney general operations.

headings.title: Permissible uses of fund moneys
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes fund expenditures for investigation, prosecution, enforcement, and consumer education.

headings.title: Ten percent surcharge on restitution

headings.title: Grandfathered retail sales from manufacturer dealerships
headings.reviewNote: Permits retail sales by manufacturers owning dealerships and applying for licensure on or before August 28, 2023, subject to grant and non-transfer.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes Motor Vehicle Franchise Practices Act applicability, binding licensees, and restricts direct manufacturer retail sales.

headings.title: Exclusion of trailers from motor vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Excludes trailers from the statutory definition of motor vehicle under franchise provisions.

headings.title: Temporary exemption for recreational vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Exempted recreational vehicle dealers and manufacturers from specific franchise provisions prior to August 1, 2002.

headings.title: Permanent exemption for recreational vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Permanently excludes recreational vehicles from the definition of motor vehicle under sections 407.810 to 407.835.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines motor vehicle for franchise provisions and establishes recreational vehicle dealer and manufacturer exemptions.

headings.title: Relevant market area mileage radii
headings.reviewNote: Defines market area as eight miles in populous counties and fifteen miles in less populous counties.

headings.title: Two-mile relocation threshold exception
headings.reviewNote: Excludes relocations within two miles of established dealership from statutory requirements.

headings.title: Notice of intention to establish or relocate
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice to existing line-make franchisees stating proposed location and business date.

headings.title: Franchisee action to challenge good cause
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes existing franchisees to file action within thirty days challenging good cause for new dealer.

headings.title: Exception for reopened closed franchises
headings.reviewNote: Exempts dealerships closed within preceding year reopened within two miles by prior franchisee.

headings.title: Good cause evaluation circumstances
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes statutory factors for evaluating good cause including dealer investments and consumer convenience.

headings.title: Applicability of statutory franchise remedies
headings.reviewNote: Applies remedies and relief under section 407.835 to market area dispute proceedings.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines relevant market areas, mandates notice before establishing or relocating franchises, and sets good cause criteria.

headings.title: Successor manufacturer franchise offer restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Requires successor manufacturers to offer terminated line-make franchises to former dealers at no cost for two years.

headings.title: Fair market value calculation date
headings.reviewNote: Establishes valuation benchmark as date yielding highest value among announcement, finality, or prior year.

entries.reviewSummary: Restricts successor manufacturers from offering line-make franchises without first offering them to former franchisees, and sets valuation dates.

headings.title: Complaint filing and automatic activity stay
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes filing complaints, requires thirty-day answers, and automatically stays challenged activities.

headings.title: Hearing procedure, discovery, enforcement, and review
headings.reviewNote: Applies chapter 536, authorizes civil discovery, sets a ninety-day decision deadline, provides circuit court enforcement, and establishes exclusive court of appeals review.

headings.title: Franchisee right to file complaint
headings.reviewNote: Entitles franchisees receiving notice or adversely affected by franchisor acts to file a complaint with the administrative hearing commission for a good-cause determination.

headings.title: Franchisor notice periods and exceptions
headings.reviewNote: Requires sixty days' certified-mail notice for enumerated franchisor acts, with fifteen-day notice exceptions and sixty-to-ninety-day review timelines for transfers and family succession.

headings.title: Required contents of franchisor notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires franchisor notices to state particular grounds and include a conspicuous first-page statement of thirty-day protest and mediation rights.

headings.title: Consolidation of related complaints
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the administrative hearing commission to consolidate multiple complaints into one proceeding to expedite disposition.

headings.title: Franchisor burden of proof
headings.reviewNote: Places the burden on the franchisor by a preponderance of the evidence to prove good faith, required notices, and good cause.

headings.title: Prevailing franchisee damages and litigation expenses
headings.reviewNote: Grants a prevailing franchisee a cause of action against the franchisor for damages and reasonable litigation expenses, including attorney fees.

headings.title: Franchisee demand for mediation
headings.reviewNote: Permits a franchisee to mail a demand for mediation after notice or before, during, or after filing a complaint, specifying effective mailing addresses.

headings.title: Stay of filing periods during mediation
headings.reviewNote: Stays the franchisee's filing deadlines upon mailing a mediation demand, restarting the first business day after the last unresolved mediation meeting.

headings.title: Stay of pending commission proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing a copy of the mediation demand in pending commission proceedings, staying further action except the subsection 1 stay order until unresolved.

headings.title: Mediator selection and meeting timelines
headings.reviewNote: Sets five-day list exchange, two-day mutual selection, judicial appointment if deadlocked, and a twenty-day deadline to meet with the mediator in Missouri.

headings.title: Franchisor panel of mediators required
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director of revenue to require each franchisor to establish and maintain a panel of mediators for state franchise disputes.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs administrative hearing commission procedures, discovery, stays, notices, burdens of proof, and mediation for franchise disputes.

headings.title: Definitions of goods and substantial reimbursement
headings.reviewNote: Defines goods and substantial reimbursement for facility improvement regulations.

headings.title: Ten-year protection against mandatory alterations
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits requiring facility alterations or sign changes replacing elements approved within ten years.

headings.title: Vendor selection rights and reimbursement
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits mandating exclusive vendors unless substantial reimbursement is paid, allowing comparable vendor approval.

headings.title: Commencement date of ten-year period
headings.reviewNote: Commences ten-year protection on date of final approval or certificate of occupancy, whichever is later.

headings.title: Brand logo signs update frequency
headings.reviewNote: Permits requiring updates to federally protected brand or logo signs more often than every ten years, requiring franchisor compensation or payment if required less than five years apart.

entries.reviewSummary: Restricts franchisors from coercing facility alterations completed within ten years and governs vendor selection and brand signs.

headings.title: Franchisor dealership ownership prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits franchisor dealership ownership, specifying exceptions for temporary transitions and minority stakes.

headings.title: Direct retail sales to consumers prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits franchisors from selling vehicles directly to consumers except through franchisees, with limited exceptions.

headings.title: Applicability of statutory franchise remedies
headings.reviewNote: Applies remedies and relief under section 407.835 to direct sales and dealership ownership violations.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits motor vehicle franchisors from owning dealerships, defines temporary and minority ownership exceptions, and restricts direct sales.

headings.title: Written warranty obligations and compensation schedule
headings.reviewNote: Requires franchisors to specify preparation, delivery, and warranty obligations in writing, fairly compensate franchisees, and provide a parts, labor, and time-allowance schedule.

headings.title: Reasonable compensation and retail rate standards
headings.reviewNote: Requires reasonable diagnostic compensation and adequate time allowances, with retail customer nonwarranty rates as the principal factor for labor and primary factor for parts.

headings.title: Warranty performance and recall repair compensation
headings.reviewNote: Requires franchisors to perform warranty obligations, include expected parts availability dates in written recall notices, and compensate recall repairs under subsection 2.

headings.title: Warranty claim submission and payment timelines
headings.reviewNote: Bars requiring claim submission under thirty days, requires approval or disapproval within thirty days and timely payment, and caps defective parts retention at thirty days.

headings.title: Compensation for promotional events and rebates
headings.reviewNote: Requires franchisors to compensate franchisees for franchisor-sponsored sales or service promotion events, rebates, and programs under written guidelines.

headings.title: Promotional claim submission and payment timelines
headings.reviewNote: Bars requiring promotional claim submission under thirty days, sets thirty-day approval or disapproval deadlines, and requires payment within ten days of approval or fifteen days if deemed approved.

headings.title: Excluded repair order categories
headings.reviewNote: Excludes manufacturer promotional discounts, wholesale parts, engine assemblies, routine maintenance, and tires.

headings.title: Compensation for parts furnished at no cost
headings.reviewNote: Requires compensating franchisees for parts furnished at no cost at average markup less cost, excluding entire engine, propulsion (including EV battery), and transmission assemblies.

headings.title: Unduly burdensome calculations prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits requiring unduly burdensome rate calculations and limits rate requests to twice annually.

headings.title: Incomplete claim notification and extension
headings.reviewNote: Requires prompt notice of incomplete claims and grants at least five business days to cure deficiencies.

headings.title: Warranty audit timelines and charge-back limits
headings.reviewNote: Limits audits to twelve months for regular claims and two years for fraud, requiring written explanation.

headings.title: Administrative complaint on claim disputes
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes franchisee complaints to administrative hearing commission within sixty days, staying adverse action.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs warranty and recall compensation for motor vehicle dealers, reimbursement formulas, parts markups, audits, and disputes.

headings.title: Mandatory indemnification for pre-delivery damage
headings.reviewNote: Requires franchisor to indemnify franchisee against liability, costs, and fees for undisclosed pre-delivery damage.

headings.title: Franchisee right to reject or repurchase
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes franchisee to reject vehicle or require repurchase if pre-delivery damage exceeds six percent of price.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires franchisors to indemnify dealers against pre-delivery vehicle damage liability and authorizes vehicle repurchase for severe damage.

headings.title: Notice of franchise modification and stay
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits adverse franchise modifications without ninety days' notice and stays changes upon complaint filing.

headings.title: Evaluation factors and burden of proof
headings.reviewNote: Places burden of proof on the franchisor, except on the franchisee for adverse-effect degree under subdivision (3), and enumerates evaluation factors.

headings.title: Written commission decision and findings
headings.reviewNote: Requires written administrative decision with findings of fact and bars unapproved modifications.

headings.title: Broad definition of franchise modification
headings.reviewNote: Defines modification to include any change, amendment, supplement, deletion, addition, or replacement.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits substantial adverse modifications of franchise agreements without ninety days' notice and authorizes administrative complaints.

headings.title: Franchisee civil action for damages
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court actions for franchise violations to recover actual damages, expenses, and injunctive relief.

headings.title: Punitive damages for willful violations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes actual damages, litigation expenses, injunctive relief, and punitive damages for willful franchisor violations.

headings.title: Franchise dispute restrictions and venue
headings.reviewNote: Establishes venue rules, governs Missouri law applicability, invalidates arbitration and jury trial waivers.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes franchisee civil actions, damages, expenses, injunctions, and invalidates arbitration, jury trial, and venue waivers.

headings.title: Repurchase percentage and handling costs
headings.reviewNote: Mandates repurchasing new inventory at one hundred percent and parts at ninety-five percent plus five percent packing.

headings.title: Transfer of title upon repurchase
headings.reviewNote: Transfers title and right of possession to repurchased inventory upon payment to retailer.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires equipment manufacturers to repurchase unsold inventory and repair parts upon contract termination, and governs packing costs.

headings.title: Obligations apply to successors in interest
headings.reviewNote: Extends equipment distributor obligations to asset purchasers, stock buyers, and surviving entities.

headings.title: Small employer exemptions and contracts
headings.reviewNote: Exempts manufacturers with under fifty employees and distributors with under five, governing contract dates.

entries.reviewSummary: Applies outdoor power equipment obligations to successors in interest, specifies employer size exemptions, and defines contract applicability.

headings.title: Fine art delivery deemed consignment
headings.reviewNote: Deems fine art delivered to dealers as consignment unless pursuant to outright paid sale.

headings.title: Written consignment contract required
headings.reviewNote: Requires a written consignment contract addressing sale proceeds delivery schedule, loss or damage liability for stated value, minimum agreed sale price, and written display consent.

entries.reviewSummary: Deems delivery of fine art to dealers as consignment and mandates written consignment contracts with specific terms.

headings.title: Determination of when commission is due
headings.reviewNote: Governs due date by contract terms, product delivery, order acceptance, or industry custom.

headings.title: Commissions on pre-termination orders
headings.reviewNote: Preserves sales representative rights to commissions on orders placed prior to contract termination.

headings.title: Payment within thirty days of termination
headings.reviewNote: Requires all earned commissions paid within thirty days of termination or becoming due.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes rules for when sales commissions become due and requires payment within thirty days of contract termination.

headings.title: Joinder of all sales commission claims
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes sales representatives to recover on all related claims against principal in single civil action.

headings.title: Waiver of sales commission statutes void
headings.reviewNote: Renders null, void, and unenforceable any contractual waiver or choice-of-law provision avoiding commission statutes.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes joinder of sales representative claims and invalidates express or choice-of-law contract waivers.

headings.title: Division of liquor control enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Directs division of liquor control to implement and enforce youth tobacco and vapor statutes.

headings.title: Annual legislative enforcement report
headings.reviewNote: Requires annual report to general assembly regarding youth tobacco reduction and enforcement actions.

entries.reviewSummary: Designates the Division of Liquor Control to enforce youth tobacco access laws and mandates annual legislative reports.

headings.title: Sale of tobacco to minors prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Requires retail sellers to deny sales of tobacco, alternative nicotine, or vapor products to minors.

headings.title: Fines for mail or online tobacco sales
headings.reviewNote: Imposes fines up to five hundred dollars for unlawful online or mail-order tobacco sales to minors.

headings.title: Age eighteen requirement and taxation
headings.reviewNote: Restricts nicotine and vapor sales to age eighteen or older and subjects products to state sales tax.

headings.title: Child-resistant liquid nicotine packaging
headings.reviewNote: Mandates child-resistant packaging standards for liquid nicotine containers, sets retail fines, authorizes rules, and provides contingent expiration upon federal child-resistant regulations.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits selling tobacco, alternative nicotine, or vapor products to minors, and mandates child-resistant liquid nicotine packaging.

headings.title: Proof of age required for tobacco sales
headings.reviewNote: Requires demanding proof of age if prospective purchaser appears to be under age eighteen.

headings.title: Acceptable government identification documents
headings.reviewNote: Specifies driver licenses, state IDs, military IDs, and passports as acceptable proof of age.

headings.title: Misdemeanor penalty for forged identification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies reproducing, altering, or misrepresenting driver licenses or IDs as misdemeanor.

headings.title: Defense of reasonable reliance on proof
headings.reviewNote: Establishes reasonable reliance on proof of age as complete defense and limits daily violations.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires age verification for tobacco sales, criminalizes ID forgery, and provides defense of reasonable reliance on proof.

headings.title: Sales and distribution to minors prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits any person from selling, providing, or distributing tobacco, alternative nicotine, or vapor products to persons under eighteen years of age.

headings.title: Tobacco vending machine location restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Restricts cigarette vending machine placement to areas inaccessible to minors unless locked or supervised.

headings.title: Rolling papers, single cigarettes, and family exception
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits furnishing tobacco, nicotine, vapor products, or rolling papers to minors and selling individual cigarettes to anyone, exempting family distribution on nonpublic property.

headings.title: Graduated fines for sales violations
headings.reviewNote: Establishes graduated fines of $25, $100, and $250 for violations by sales clerks, owners, or operators.

headings.title: Graduated establishment license suspensions
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes reprimands and sales suspensions up to five days for recurring retail establishment violations.

headings.title: Affirmative defense of employee training program
headings.reviewNote: Exempts retail owners from penalties if documented compliance training was provided to selling employees.

headings.title: Inapplicability of training defense
headings.reviewNote: Disqualifies owners from training defense after four violations in one year or for knowing violations.

headings.title: Individual liability for employees and samplers
headings.reviewNote: Imposes individual violation liability on selling clerks, vending machine owners, and product samplers.

headings.title: Presumption of reasonable reliance on photo ID
headings.reviewNote: Creates conclusive presumption of reasonable reliance when minor presented government photo identification.

headings.title: Administrative hearing commission appeals
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes adversely affected persons to file appeals with administrative hearing commission under chapter 621.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits furnishing tobacco products to minors, establishes graduated clerk and owner penalties, and provides employee training defenses.

headings.title: Tobacco possession by minors prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits minors from purchasing or possessing tobacco products, exempting retail employment and enforcement.

headings.title: Misrepresentation of age by minor prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits persons under age eighteen from misrepresenting age to purchase tobacco or vapor products.

headings.title: Infraction penalties and product confiscation
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violations as infractions with product confiscation, and requires completing a tobacco education or smoking cessation program, if available, for second and subsequent violations.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits purchase or possession of tobacco products by minors, misrepresentation of age, and mandates product confiscation.

headings.title: Sales tax license required for tobacco sales
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits selling cigarettes, tobacco, or vapor products without valid retail sales tax license.

headings.title: Department designation of tobacco sellers
headings.reviewNote: Requires department of revenue to provide internet and application designations for tobacco sellers.

headings.title: Annual list of licensed tobacco sellers
headings.reviewNote: Requires department of revenue to provide annual list of tobacco sellers to liquor control and mental health.

headings.title: Liquor control retail inspection authority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes division of liquor control to inspect retail outlets and employ seventeen-year-olds for compliance.

headings.title: Mandatory guidelines for minor compliance stings
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes mandatory standards for minor stings including parental consent, recordings, and photo IDs.

headings.title: Bar on discipline for noncompliant stings
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits the supervisor of liquor control from disciplining sellers or cooperating in prosecutions based on minor investigations that violate subsection 5 guidelines.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires retail sales tax licenses to sell tobacco, authorizes inspections, and sets strict guidelines for using minors in stings.

headings.title: Three-day right to cancel consulting contract
headings.reviewNote: Grants homeowner right to cancel foreclosure consulting contract until midnight of third business day.

headings.title: Business day calculation excluding holidays
headings.reviewNote: Excludes intervening Saturdays, Sundays, and legal state and national holidays from cancellation period.

headings.title: Effective date of mailed cancellation notice
headings.reviewNote: Provides that notice of cancellation by mail is effective upon deposit in United States mail.

headings.title: Form and expression of cancellation notice
headings.reviewNote: Provides that cancellation notice is effective however expressed if indicating intent not to be bound.

entries.reviewSummary: Grants property owners a three-day right to cancel foreclosure consulting contracts and governs notice delivery.

headings.title: Written contract and fee disclosure required
headings.reviewNote: Requires written contract fully disclosing exact services and total compensation terms.

headings.title: Mandatory 14-point boldface fee prohibition notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires 14-point boldface notice that consultant cannot demand money before completing work or take liens.

headings.title: Conspicuous 10-point cancellation disclosure
headings.reviewNote: Requires conspicuous 10-point bold statement regarding owner's right to cancel within three business days.

headings.title: First-page consultant contact information
headings.reviewNote: Requires consultant name, business address, and execution date on first page of contract.

headings.title: Detachable notice of cancellation form
headings.reviewNote: Requires attaching duplicate detachable 10-point cancellation notice forms in contract language.

headings.title: Delivery of completed contract copy to owner
headings.reviewNote: Requires foreclosure consultant to provide property owner with copies of contract and cancellation form.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates written foreclosure consulting contracts, 14-point boldface advance payment warnings, and detachable cancellation forms.

headings.title: Unlawful foreclosure consulting acts enumerated
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits advance fees, interest exceeding ten percent, taking property liens, or powers of attorney.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor for consulting violations
headings.reviewNote: Classifies any violation of the unlawful foreclosure consulting acts enumerated in subsection 1 as a class A misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines unlawful foreclosure consulting practices, prohibits advance fees, excessive interest, and liens, and establishes class A misdemeanor penalties.

headings.title: Homeowner civil action for damages
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes property owners to sue consultants for actual damages, attorney fees, and exemplary damages.

headings.title: Cumulative remedies and three-year limitation
headings.reviewNote: Provides cumulative remedies and requires commencing civil actions within three years of violation.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes homeowner civil actions for foreclosure consulting violations, exemplary damages, equitable relief, and three-year limitations.

headings.title: Definitions for assistive device warranties
headings.reviewNote: Defines assistive device, dealer, lessor, consumer, demonstrator, early termination, and nonconformity.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines terms applicable to assistive device warranties including consumer, demonstrator, early termination costs, nonconformity, and repairs.

headings.title: Manufacturer duty after failed repairs
headings.reviewNote: Requires manufacturer to replace device or issue refund if nonconformity is unrepaired.

headings.title: Consumer replacement and refund options
headings.reviewNote: Provides options for comparable replacement or purchase/lease refunds less reasonable use allowance.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates replacement or refund for defective assistive devices failing repair, including lease value refunds and use allowances.

headings.title: Calculation of current lease value
headings.reviewNote: Sets formula adding remaining lease obligations and dealer costs less lessor early savings.

headings.title: Calculation of reasonable allowance for use
headings.reviewNote: Sets formula capping allowance for use based on days used divided by eighteen hundred twenty-five.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes formulas for calculating current lease value and reasonable allowance for use upon early termination of assistive device leases.

headings.title: Transfer offer and thirty-day refund timeline
headings.reviewNote: Requires manufacturer to furnish replacement or refund within thirty days of consumer transfer offer.

headings.title: Lease refund procedure for consumer lessees
headings.reviewNote: Requires manufacturer refund within thirty days of lessee return offer and surrender of device.

headings.title: Lessor refund and legal title transfer
headings.reviewNote: Requires manufacturer refund to lessor within thirty days of transfer offer and endorsement of title.

headings.title: Lease unenforceable following consumer refund
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits enforcing lease agreements against consumers following receipt of statutory refunds.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes return and refund procedures for defective assistive devices, manufacturer timelines, and bars post-refund lease enforcement.

headings.title: Consumer arbitration option and fee
headings.reviewNote: Grants consumers the option to submit warranty disputes to alternate arbitration upon paying filing fee.

headings.title: Independent arbitrator appointment standards
headings.reviewNote: Requires professional arbitrators appointed under attorney general rules ensuring personal objectivity and hearing rights.

headings.title: Preservation of independent statutory remedies
headings.reviewNote: Provides that assistive device arbitration provisions do not limit rights or remedies under other laws.

headings.title: Consumer waivers declared void
headings.reviewNote: Renders null, void, and unenforceable any waiver by a consumer of assistive device rights.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes consumer dispute arbitration for assistive device warranties, preserves legal remedies, and declares waivers void.

headings.title: Rulemaking approval by joint committee
headings.reviewNote: Conditions effectiveness of administrative rules upon approval by joint committee on administrative rules.

headings.title: Concurrent submission of proposed rules
headings.reviewNote: Requires attorney general to submit proposed rules concurrently to the joint committee for hearings.

headings.title: Thirty-day review before final order filing
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits filing final orders of rulemaking until thirty days after committee receipt and review.

headings.title: Statutory grounds for rule suspension
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes committee to suspend proposed rules for lack of statutory authority, conflict, or emergency.

headings.title: Prohibition against filing disapproved rules
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits filing or publishing in the Missouri Register any rule or portion disapproved by committee.

headings.title: Legislative ratification of rule disapproval
headings.reviewNote: Requires senate and house resolutions within thirty legislative days to ratify committee disapproval.

headings.title: Legislative revocation and publication
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes general assembly to suspend or revoke adopted rules by bill or concurrent resolution.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes administrative rulemaking procedures, legislative committee review, and legislative revocation for assistive device regulations.

headings.title: Convenience business defined and exclusions
headings.reviewNote: Defines late-night retail grocery establishments, excluding restaurants, large stores, and single-location businesses.

headings.title: State preemption of local security rules
headings.reviewNote: Preempts and supersedes all local municipal and county convenience business security regulations.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines convenience businesses, enumerates establishment exclusions, and preempts differing local security standards.

headings.title: Mandatory convenience security equipment
headings.reviewNote: Requires security cameras, drop safes, clear parking lighting, warning notices, height markers, and cash limits.

headings.title: Silent alarm or telephone access requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires silent alarm connected to police or security company, or accessible employee telephone.

headings.title: Window visibility and tinting restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits window signs or window tinting that obstructs outside view of cash registers.

headings.title: Convenience business operator defined
headings.reviewNote: Defines operator as individual proprietor or entity responsible for day-to-day business operations.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates security equipment, lighting, cash management, silent alarms, and clear window sightlines for convenience businesses.
